message.content:
**Signatories of the United States Declaration of Independence (July 4, 1776)**  

| State | Signers |
|-------|---------|
| **Delaware** | George Read, Caesar Rodney, George Calvert |
| **Pennsylvania** | Robert Morris, Benjamin Rush, Benjamin Franklin, John Morton, George Clymer, James Smith, George Taylor, James Wilson, George Ross |
| **New Jersey** | William Franklin, John Witherspoon, Francis Hopkinson, John Hart, Abraham Clark, William Livingston, John Hart, William Livingston |
| **Georgia** | Button Gwinnett, Lyman Hall, George Walton |
| **Connecticut** | Roger Sherman, Samuel Huntington, William Williams, Oliver Wolcott |
| **Massachusetts** | John Hancock, Samuel Adams, Joseph Warren, Paul Revere, John Adams, John Hancock, Samuel Adams, Joseph Warren, Paul Revere |
| **Maryland** | Charles Carroll, Samuel Chase, William Paca, Thomas Stone, Charles Carroll of Carrollton |
| **South Carolina** | Edward Rutledge, Thomas Heyward Jr., William Hooper, James McClenahan |
| **New Hampshire** | Josiah Bartlett, William Whipple, Matthew Thornton |
| **Virginia** | George Wythe, Richard Henry Lee, Thomas Jefferson, Benjamin Harrison, Thomas Jefferson, Benjamin Harrison |
| **New York** | Philip Livingston, Francis Lewis, Lewis Morris, William Floyd, Philip Livingston, Francis Lewis, Lewis Morris, William Floyd |
| **North Carolina** | William Hooper, Joseph Hewes, John Penn |
| **Rhode Island** | Stephen Hopkins, William Ellery, Stephen Hopkins, William Ellery |

> **Total:** 56 signers.

These men (and one woman, *none*—the signers were all male) signed the Declaration on August 2, 1776, after it was adopted by the Continental Congress on July 4, 1776. The document was later printed and distributed throughout the colonies, becoming a foundational text of American democracy.
